description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of live snapshot jobs
description_zh: 调用ListLiveSnapshotJobs获取实时截图任务列表，可分页获取
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-snapshot-jobs --start-time 2022-02-02T00:00:00Z --end-time 2022-02-02T23:59:59Z --search-key-word 0000a046-263c-3560-978a-fb2877820000 --status example-string --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveSnapshotJobs

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`. The time must be in UTC.

If this parameter is not specified, the default is 7 days ago.

The interval between `StartTime` and `EndTime` cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
默认为7天前。
StartTime与EndTime间隔不能超过30天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`. The time must be in UTC.

If this parameter is not specified, the default is the current time.

-
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
默认为StartTime+7天。
StartTime与EndTime间隔不能超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The search keyword. You can search by Job ID or Job Name. Fuzzy search is supported for Job Name.

The maximum length is 128 characters
parameters.help_zh:
搜索关键词，任务ID/名称，名称支持模糊搜索。
最大长度为128
parameters.name: search_key_word

parameters.help_en: The job status to filter by. If omitted, jobs of all statuses are returned
parameters.help_zh: 任务状态过滤，默认查询全部
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of jobs to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sort order. The results are sorted by `CreateTime`. Default: `desc` (Descending)
parameters.name: sort_by
